purpose: Qualify a statement to prevent an exaggerated interpretation.
keywords: Plain form + といっても; noun / な-adjective stem + といっても
It is a trip, but only to the next town.
I can cook, but only simple things.
It may be spring, but it is still cold.
formation: Plain form + といっても; noun / な-adjective stem + といっても
restrictions: The first description is accepted, then its actual extent is narrowed.
mistake: It does not completely deny the first description; it corrects what might be inferred.
